look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Checkpoint A
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 3 checkpoint CPA, review of T01 to T13; a ring with a shield draws in; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: How it works
scenes.desc: Eight questions from T01 to T13, most about risk: read, pause, pick, countdown, see why. Not graded.

scenes.name: Q1 account security
scenes.desc: T04: 'support' asks for a 2FA code and API secret key; never share either; open the official app yourself.

scenes.name: Q2 spot vs futures
scenes.desc: T05/T11: spot is owning the coin; futures are contracts on its price with margin, funding and liquidation.

scenes.name: Q3 net result
scenes.desc: T06/T09: gross +4 USDT minus 3 + 3 USDT fees = -2 USDT net; bars fall below zero.

scenes.name: Q4 stop slippage
scenes.desc: T07/T08: stop at 59,000, price gaps 59,300 to 58,600; it may fill near 58,600 or worse.

scenes.name: Q5 leverage maths
scenes.desc: T12: 100 USDT margin at 10x, BTC -2%: notional 1,000 x -2% = -20 USDT, 20% of margin.

scenes.name: Q6 no safe leverage
scenes.desc: T12: leverage magnifies gains and losses alike; no leverage number is safe.

scenes.name: Q7 stop vs liquidation
scenes.desc: T13: a stop-loss cannot guarantee no liquidation; the liquidation zone can come first.

scenes.name: Q8 funding
scenes.desc: T13: long, 2,000 USDT notional, rate +0.01%: you pay 0.20 USDT.

scenes.name: Critical safety
scenes.desc: Leverage and liquidation, stop-loss limits, never share codes or keys, WAIT / NO_TRADE and demo only.

scenes.name: Where to revisit
scenes.desc: Which lesson each question came from; rewatch with no penalty.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: Phase 4 starts with T14, Candlesticks: Open, High, Low, Close.
